text: Scientists found a pill that burns fat... without eating less.
Do you know what happens when your body just... burns more?
Drugs like Ozempic work by making you less hungry.
But some people lose muscle too. And the weight often comes back.
Now scientists at UC Berkeley tested an old compound called TOFA.
Obese mice ate the exact same food...
and still lost eighteen percent of their body weight.
Their bodies burned up to eighteen percent more energy.
Mix it with Ozempic-style drugs... and the results got even better.
And when treatment stopped, the weight didn't rush back.
Here's the catch. It's only been tested in male mice.
No human trials yet. So nobody knows the right dose, or if it's safe long term.
But if it works in people...
the next weight loss pill might not make you eat less. It might make you burn more.
